notes: "karbon atau media penjerap seumpamanya dikeluarkan": facts say carbon or Purigen; "media penjerap seumpamanya" is a generalisation of Purigen.
"ikan yang dijangkiti perlu dipindahkan ke tangki rawatan" for columnaris: the facts say hospital tank, which is close, but the guide ties it to fin rot in a way the facts don't state.

"ikan laga kerap terkena reput sirip kerana keadaan di kedai ikan hiasan tidak disokong oleh rujukan": the facts only say the claim lacks a citation (Wikipedia). The guide's wording is slightly loose.

"Kanamycin ... boleh dicampurkan ke dalam makanan ... ikut sukatan dan bahan campuran dalam arahan pengeluar": the facts give the mix of 1 scoop KanaPlex, 1 scoop Focus and 1 tbsp food, but the guide leaves it out. This is an omission, not an invented claim.
"Reput ... biasanya oleh bakteria" in the intro: broadly supported, but "biasanya" is a mild generalisation.
"Bakteria ini biasanya memang hidup di dalam air atau dalam lendir kulit ikan" merges two sources; acceptable but slightly blended.
"Asingkan ikan yang suka menggigit atau bergaduh" in step 2: the facts say remove nippers, so this is fine. The facts do not say to isolate fighting fish in this step.
"Pemakanan yang tidak baik dan makanan berlebihan" lists overfeeding as a predisposing factor. The facts name overfeeding as a stressor, so this is a minor generalisation.
"Ubat hanya digunakan jika ikan tidak pulih ... atau jika jangkitan semakin teruk" in the intro: the facts give no 'if the infection worsens' criterion.
"Pandangan sumber berbeza" is the guide's framing, not a fact. It is mild.

"Ubat ini juga boleh dicampur ke dalam makanan ... sehingga 1 minggu": the facts give the recipe (1 scoop KanaPlex, 1 scoop Focus, 1 tbsp food). The guide leaves out the Focus part, but nothing in it is invented.
"Bila perlu risau" bullet 'Reput sudah sampai ke pangkal sirip' as a worry trigger is the guide's own inference. The facts only say tissue cannot regrow.
"Jika mulut ikan turut reput, mungkin itu penyakit columnaris" is a mild extrapolation from the facts. The facts only say columnaris is highly contagious and fish should go to a hospital tank.
"Sumber yang sama mencadangkan suhu air 26–27 °C dan pH 7–8" says 'same source' about the second source (Mytour). This is correct, but 'sumber yang sama' reads ambiguously.

"Penternak menggunakan suplemen mineral untuk mengelakkannya" - the facts only name Wonder Shell/Seachem Equilibrium as skipped minerals. The guide generalizes without naming them, and the claim about what keepers do is slightly beyond the facts.
"Asingkan betina sebelum dia hampir bersalin" in the intro presents separation as a firm rule. The facts say sources differ, and one suggests a divider instead of moving her.

"Jika perut membengkak tetapi gravid spot tidak kelihatan, kemungkinan itu dropsy atau masalah pundi renang" - this is an inference. The facts only say the gravid spot is the key way to tell them apart, not that a missing spot means disease.
"Betina yang bunting juga sering mengejar jantan" is supported. The "Bila perlu risau" heading is the guide's own framing, and the facts don't say when to worry.
"Tangki kira-kira 38 liter": facts say about 10 gallons; the liter conversion is not in the facts (though it is roughly right).
"Jadi betina yang sudah diasingkan daripada jantan masih boleh bunting lagi": this is an inference the facts don't state.
"Jika kandungan lewat melebihi jangka biasa, periksa kualiti air": the facts only say poor water can delay birth. They don't give this advice for an overdue pregnancy.
"Pastikan keadaan airnya sama seperti tangki utama": the facts say this for the nursery tank. The guide moves it into the birthing setup, which is a minor shift.
"Gunakan penapis yang perlahan": the facts say 'gentle filtration'. The 'penapis span' example comes from the colony-breeding source.
"Jika perut besar dan tompok ... semakin gelap ... kemungkinan besar ikan itu bunting": this is a mild generalisation, but it is consistent with the facts.
"suplemen mineral untuk akuarium": the facts name Wonder Shell and Seachem Equilibrium. The guide generalises them, which is acceptable.
"Untuk ikan omnivor seperti ikan emas" in the intro is a small generalisation; the facts say peas suit omnivores but do not call goldfish omnivores.
"serangga air kecil" for the betta live food: the facts say "water bugs", which is close, but "daphnia (bo bo)" and the rest match. This is a minor loose translation.
"Kekalkan suhu air ikan emas di atas lebih kurang 70°F" is supported, but the earlier advice "Naikkan suhu secara perlahan" in the summary is only loosely backed.
"Ikan selalunya mengambil masa beberapa jam untuk pulih" is worded as general fish recovery. The facts tie this only to a shock-like presentation.
"jeli petroleum" for Vaseline is fine, but the guide gives no context for the advice beyond "bahagian badan yang terkeluar dari air".
"Antibiotik berasaskan kanamycin atau minocycline" – facts only name KanaPlex or Maracyn 2; the active ingredients are not in the facts.
"sisik menegak" – facts say "raised scales"; the wording is close, but "ikan emas/serangga air" detail is fine. Minor.
"Ikan selalunya pulih dalam beberapa jam" – facts say recovery from shock often takes a few hours; stated as a general outcome.

"(kira-kira 19 liter)" for 5 gallons and "kira-kira 26–27°C", "kira-kira 21°C", "5°C" – conversions not in facts (approximately correct, but added). The 5-gallon conversion is slightly off (about 19 L is right for US gallons).
"Biarkan air hanya beberapa sentimeter" – facts say a few inches; unit changed to centimetres, which understates the depth.
"kutu air" for daphnia (bo bo) and "serangga air" for water bugs – loose translations.
"Tempoh puasa... Sumber lain" and "Pastikan kitaran nitrogen tangki sudah lengkap" – paraphrase of "cycle the tank"; acceptable.
FAQ "kalau ramai ikan bertindak pelik, uji air dulu" – an inference not stated in the facts.

"Keracunan ammonia, nitrit atau nitrat... boleh membuatkan ikan berenang tidak terkawal" – facts only list ammonia as a nervous-system look-alike, and nitrate for goldfish. Nitrite is not stated to cause this.
"kira-kira 19 liter" for 5 gallons is a conversion not in the facts (arithmetically fine, but added).
"Langkah pertama... supaya ammonia dan nitrit kembali ke sifar" and "Selepas itu barulah pilih rawatan" is an ordering the facts do not state.
The intro says popeye is "akibat penyakit lain, kecederaan atau jangkitan"; this is a loose paraphrase of the facts.

"Rendaman garam untuk punca parasit ... Dalam tangki berasingan" merges the 1–3% bath with the separate-tank note. The facts list the separate tank for the formalin/salt/malachite green treatments, not for the bath specifically.
"Permukaan luar mata... Mata juga mungkin menunjukkan bintik putih atau merah" is fine, but the source for the bintik is a general fish description, not popeye-specific.
"Ikan emas dan cichlid besar ... menghasilkan banyak kotoran" is fine, but the guide says "popeye biasanya akibat penyakit... bukannya penyakit yang berdiri sendiri", which adds emphasis.

"Popeye pada kedua-dua mata lebih cenderung ke arah masalah kualiti air atau penyakit dalaman" - the facts do not say bilateral popeye points to water quality or internal disease. This is an invented diagnostic rule, repeated in the FAQ.

"Popeye pada sebelah mata sahaja mungkin berpunca daripada kecederaan" - the facts say injury may cause one-eye popeye. The guide extends this into a diagnostic rule and adds "digigit ikan lain" in the FAQ, which is slightly beyond the facts.
"Jika kedua-dua mata terkena, atau ikan juga berperut buncit... punca yang lebih mungkin ialah kualiti air atau penyakit dalaman seperti dropsy" - an unsupported inference.
"tuberkulosis ikan" and "penyakit buah pinggang" are slight embellishments. The facts say only "tuberculosis" and "kidney disease".
"Ichthyophthirius multifiliis (penyakit bintik putih)" - the white spot disease label is not in the facts.
"kerana itu tandanya masalah dalaman yang lebih serius" (dropsy) - not stated in the facts.
"Sebab itu ikan yang sakit perlu diasingkan" - an extra rationale that the facts do not state for this point.
"supaya ikan tidak panik dan melanggar dinding tangki" - the facts say only that the fish should not panic and crash. Reading it as hitting the tank walls is a minor addition.
